routes.request: Create or review a resume or application packet
routes.target: Riley Morgan · AI orchestrator → Priya Desai · Job search orchestrator → Evidence-led Job Search Playbook
first_reads: docs/job-search/application-context-and-review.md: Local packet operation is the routine default
one active private source-bound candidate profile, including baseline facts, original evidence passages, source revisions and standing decisions; bootstrap or refresh only when needed
current employer posting and application requirements for each role
scripts/application-packet.py: run once with the private profile, one role draft and local output folder; review actual files and PDF previews
docs/playbooks/evidence-led-job-search.md only for campaign/exception guidance beyond routine packet production
docs/job-search/application-tracker-contract.md and the existing private tracker only when opportunity/application tracking is in scope, after file delivery
scripts/application-packet.mjs only for explicitly needed native-baseline fidelity or Drive/Applications compatibility
Template catalog and verified rickvang/template-library source/revision only when using an external reusable Template
candidate-context-integration.md or resume-template-mapping.md only for unresolved candidate/source conflicts or external Template semantic mapping
docs/job-search/job-ledger-contract.md only when discovery/deduplication is in scope
docs/job-search/application-work-order-template.md only when unique execution/recovery state warrants it
non_triggers: Uploading, submitting, contacting an employer, or externally sharing without a separate explicit request
Claiming provider-specific rules without current evidence
Treating Riley Morgan as the Job Search Persona or sole domain expert
Storing private job-search history inside Persona-Library
Treating the Playbook itself as the actor or domain owner
Treating a full application packet as one combined document instead of separate role-folder artifacts
Using a private Drive master as the canonical reusable Template when template-library has not been checked and verified
Mixing evidence, standing decisions, voice rules, contact details, or validation overlays from different candidate contexts
Treating a cached profile as career authority or ignoring changed baseline facts/standing decisions; preserve source references and refresh conflicts
routes.next_handoff: Execute the routine local packet path directly: reuse one valid private source-bound profile, read the employer posting, write one role draft, run scripts/application-packet.py, review source meaning, role fit, candidate voice and every final PDF page, then deliver. Preserve factual identity and source-backed claims while selecting relevant content and recording omissions. Unknown application answers do not block document production. The command has no network/model/tracker dependency; its mechanical checks do not prove editorial quality, DOCX layout or employer ATS behavior. Use an actual Word-compatible renderer when DOCX is the submission format. Bootstrap/refresh source context when missing, changed or conflicting. Template research, native Drive export, independent specialists, detailed notes and Work Orders are conditional. Tracking follows delivery when requested; resolve existing owner-scoped records, preserve later confirmed states and pending answers, and never infer Applied or submission dates. Priya owns full-outcome job-search orchestration; direct execution requires no extra runtime handoff. Preparation does not authorize submission, outreach or external sharing. For unqualified narrow requests, Riley Morgan routes to the matching specialist or Skill; unqualified full-outcome requests use Priya and the Playbook. Explicit specialist, Skill or Playbook requests route directly. The Playbook owns stages, shared state, quality gates, recovery and the learning loop. A valid candidate baseline projection preserves the career spine and standing decisions; secondary profile stores cannot replace unresolved authoritative sources. When tracking is in scope, resolve the existing tracker record by stable ID and sourceUrl before creating a duplicate; preserve source-backed postingDate, record packetUrl and honest Packet Ready only after review and required answers. Applied/appliedDate require confirmed submission; later states require confirmed events.
